summary: PASS on all P0 items for the logout-online-badge bug fix. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases green (auth guard, DB back-dating, /status/for-users offline, idempotency, heartbeat recovery, manual-status clearing). Frontend (Playwright, mobile viewport 390x844): (a) demo-login maggie → /profile → tap Log Out → captured POST /api/status/sign-off returning 200 BEFORE persist(null,null); (b) resilience — network route forced sign-off to 500, logout still completed cleanly (yb_token & yb_user cleared, landed on welcome). No regressions in the status precedence stack or the sign-off endpoint's auth guard.
action_items: None — bug fix is verified end-to-end. Note: iteration_104 flagged a separate SLA issue (status-context.tsx effective refresh cadence is 60s worst-case, not 30s) which is NOT addressed by this iteration and is still open. Even with the new sign-off, an observer's *next batch* can still be up to ~60s away because of that TTL race; the sign-off patch guarantees the answer will be 'offline' as soon as the next batch fires, but the client's polling cadence is the remaining gap between the change and the observer seeing it.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.tsx L179-190: try/catch around api.statusSignOff() correctly makes logout resilient — verified by forcing a 500 in Playwright and confirming persist(null,null) still fired.

services/status/service.py sign_off(): correct approach — back-dates last_seen_at by 10 min (2× the 5-min OFFLINE_AFTER_SEC threshold) so compute_effective_status returns 'offline' immediately. Also clears manual_status_* and in_cafe_* fields. Idempotent via upsert.
router.py /status/sign-off: routed under the same current_user dep as /me and /heartbeat, so 401-guard is automatic (verified). Returns {ok: true} — matches statusSignOff() call site in api.ts.

OPEN (not in scope of this iter): iteration_104's status-context.tsx TTL race still stands — the sign-off endpoint gives the correct answer, but the observer's poll cadence gates when they *see* that answer.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing demo accounts (maggie, member@friendplace.com.au / TestPass2026!) per /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter105_status_sign_off.py is the regression harness for this fix — run with `pytest backend/tests/test_iter105_status_sign_off.py -v` under EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL/MONGO_URL/DB_NAME env. Frontend regression: login as any demo user, tap Log Out on /profile, watch the Network tab for POST /api/status/sign-off returning 200 before the redirect. Note that iteration_104's still-open 30s SLA issue is orthogonal — the sign-off endpoint is only half the fix; the other half (observer polling cadence) belongs to /app/frontend/src/lib/status-context.tsx.
rca_of_issue: Root cause was that logout only cleared the local session (persist(null,null)) — server-side member_status.last_seen_at stayed fresh from the client's last heartbeat, so compute_effective_status kept returning 'online' for up to 5 minutes until the natural stale-heartbeat decay. Fix (verified working): backend now exposes POST /api/status/sign-off which back-dates last_seen_at by 10 minutes (2× the 5-min OFFLINE_AFTER_SEC threshold) and clears manual_status_* + in_cafe_* fields. Client auth.tsx.logout() calls api.statusSignOff() BEFORE persist(null,null), wrapped in try/catch so a failed sign-off doesn't block logout (also verified — forced 500 still cleared session and landed on welcome).
